run_semantic_segmentation_evaluation: run the eval.py script to evaluate a semantic segmentation model on a validation dataset with multiscale testing
evaluate_segmentation_module: evaluate a SegmentationModule on a data loader and compute mean IoU, accuracy, and inference time
visualize_segmentation_result: visualize segmentation predictions by concatenating original image, ground truth, and predicted segmentation side by side
build_segmentation_module: build a SegmentationModule with a specified encoder architecture, decoder architecture, and pre-trained weights
compute_intersection_and_union: compute per-class intersection and union metrics for semantic segmentation evaluation using predicted and ground truth labels
